FUNCTION COUNT_VOWELS ACCEPTS(text)
  vowels <- LIST [STRING("a"), STRING("e"), STRING("i"), STRING("o"), STRING("u")]
  counts <- EMPTY LIST
  FOR v IN vowels
    count <- 0
    FOR c IN text
      IF c == v THEN
        count <- count + 1
      END IF
    END FOR
    counts <- counts + [count]
  END FOR
  RETURN counts
END FUNCTION
